invoice.list.title.note: The /invoices screen. 'Verkoopfacturen' (sales invoices), not plain 'Facturen': purchase invoices are a different module and a bookkeeper reads the distinction as load-bearing.

invoice.list.new.note: The one primary action on the list (D1).

invoice.list.column.number.note: FR-GL-013: the statutory number series. A draft has none yet — see invoice.list.draft_reference.

invoice.list.column.status.note: Identical in both: 'status' is the ordinary Dutch word as well, and 'toestand' would be stilted.

invoice.list.draft_reference.note: Stands in for the number column on a draft. A draft deliberately holds no number: the series is gapless (FR-GL-013), so a number is allocated at issue and never before — showing a provisional one would be showing a number that can still change.

invoice.list.empty_body.nl: Maak uw eerste factuur. U kiest een klant, vult de regels in, en verstuurt hem als PDF per e-mail.
invoice.list.empty_body.en: Create your first invoice. Pick a customer, fill in the lines, and send it as a PDF by email.

invoice.new.customer_pick.note: FR-AR-006: the customer master is the source, so an invoice names a customer rather than re-typing an address that would then differ from the one on file.

invoice.new.customer_typed.note: The empty option in the customer select: the person types the details on this invoice instead of picking a saved customer.

invoice.new.customer_address_incomplete.note: FR-AR-003: a sales invoice must carry the buyer's full address (art. 35a Wet OB), so a customer record missing one cannot be invoiced until it is completed. Names the screen that fixes it (D5).
invoice.new.customer_address_incomplete.nl: Van deze klant ontbreekt het adres. Een factuur moet het volledige adres van de afnemer vermelden (art. 35a Wet OB). Vul het aan bij Klanten.
invoice.new.customer_address_incomplete.en: This customer has no address on file. An invoice must state the buyer's full address (art. 35a Wet OB). Complete it under Customers.

invoice.new.customers_unavailable.note: The customer list could not be loaded. The invoice is still writable by typing the details, so this is a degradation, not a dead end (D5).
invoice.new.customers_unavailable.nl: De klantenlijst kan nu niet worden geladen. U kunt de gegevens hieronder zelf invullen.
invoice.new.customers_unavailable.en: The customer list can't be loaded right now. You can enter the details below instead.

invoice.new.irreversible.note: D7: sending is one of the genuinely irreversible acts, so it is stated plainly before the button rather than behind an 'are you sure?'. A sent invoice is corrected by a credit note (FR-AR-004), never by editing.
invoice.new.irreversible.nl: Versturen kan niet ongedaan worden gemaakt. Een verstuurde factuur corrigeert u met een creditnota.
invoice.new.irreversible.en: Sending cannot be undone. A sent invoice is corrected with a credit note.

invoice.detail.heading.note: {reference} is the statutory number once issued, and the draft label before that — see invoice.list.draft_reference.

invoice.detail.line_net.note: Column header over the per-line amount. Net, because VAT is summarised per rate below rather than per line (FR-AR-002).

invoice.detail.net_and_vat.note: The subtotal line. Both amounts are already formatted in the ADMINISTRATION's locale (FR-LOC-002) before they reach this message.

invoice.detail.vat_group.note: FR-AR-002: VAT totalled per rate. {rate} is the percentage, {taxable} the amount it applies to.

invoice.detail.vat_group_no_rate.note: The treatments that carry no percentage at all — reverse charge, intra-community supply, exempt. {treatment} is the treatment's own translated name, so this message must not restate it.

invoice.detail.pdf.note: Opens the stored rendering — FR-TPL-017: the PDF is kept, not re-rendered, so what is opened is exactly what the customer received.

invoice.detail.pdf_none.note: A draft has no PDF because nothing has been issued yet. Stated rather than showing a button that would fail.
invoice.detail.pdf_none.nl: Er is nog geen PDF: die wordt aangemaakt zodra u de factuur definitief maakt.
invoice.detail.pdf_none.en: There's no PDF yet — it's created when you issue the invoice.

invoice.detail.finish_draft.note: The primary action on a draft: continue where the invoice was left (D6, never lose work).

invoice.detail.timeline.note: D9, show the source: what happened to this invoice and when, so a question about it is answered on the invoice rather than in the audit log.

invoice.detail.event.issued_number.note: FR-GL-013: the moment the gapless series allocated this invoice its number.

invoice.detail.event.posted.note: FR-GL-003: the entry is permanent from here, which is why issuing and posting are shown as separate events rather than one. 'grootboek' stays Dutch in the English UI (FR-LOC-001c, see glossary.json) — an English-speaking owner in the Netherlands deals with a grootboek, not with whatever their own country calls a ledger.

invoice.detail.event.now.note: The relative time on the newest event, where a date would read as oddly formal for something that just happened.

invoice.required.supplier_name.note: FR-AR-003 / D5. Every message in this block states WHAT is missing, WHY the law wants it, and WHERE to go and fix it — the three things D5 requires. The citation is part of the 'why': a person who does not believe the product will believe the statute.
invoice.required.supplier_name.nl: De naam van je onderneming ontbreekt. Een factuur moet de volledige naam van de verkoper vermelden (art. 35a Wet OB). Vul de bedrijfsnaam in bij de gegevens van deze administratie.
invoice.required.supplier_name.en: Your business name is missing. An invoice must show the seller's full name (art. 35a Wet OB). Add it in this administration's details.

invoice.required.supplier_address.note: FR-AR-003 / D5. Names the three parts, because the gate checks all three and 'address' alone leaves somebody guessing which is absent.
invoice.required.supplier_address.nl: Het adres van je onderneming ontbreekt. Een factuur moet het adres van de verkoper vermelden (art. 35a Wet OB). Vul straat, postcode en plaats in bij de gegevens van deze administratie.
invoice.required.supplier_address.en: Your business address is missing. An invoice must show the seller's address (art. 35a Wet OB). Add the street, postcode and city in this administration's details.

invoice.required.supplier_vat_number.nl: Het BTW-nummer van je onderneming ontbreekt. Dat is verplicht op elke factuur (art. 35a Wet OB). Vul het in bij de gegevens van deze administratie.
invoice.required.supplier_vat_number.en: Your business BTW number is missing. Every invoice must carry it (art. 35a Wet OB). Add it in this administration's details.

invoice.required.supplier_kvk_number.note: Not art. 35a: the KvK number is required on Dutch commercial documents by the Handelsregisterwet. The 'why' cites the right statute rather than the convenient one.
invoice.required.supplier_kvk_number.nl: Het KvK-nummer van je onderneming ontbreekt. Dat hoort op elk handelsdocument te staan (Handelsregisterwet). Vul het in bij de gegevens van deze administratie.
invoice.required.supplier_kvk_number.en: Your KvK number is missing. Dutch commercial documents must carry it (Handelsregisterwet). Add it in this administration's details.

invoice.required.customer_name.nl: De naam van de klant ontbreekt. Een factuur moet de afnemer volledig benoemen (art. 35a Wet OB). Vul de naam in bij de klantgegevens van deze factuur.
invoice.required.customer_name.en: The customer's name is missing. An invoice must name the recipient in full (art. 35a Wet OB). Add it to this invoice's customer details.

invoice.required.customer_address.nl: Het adres van de klant ontbreekt. Een factuur moet het adres van de afnemer vermelden (art. 35a Wet OB). Vul het in bij de klantgegevens van deze factuur.
invoice.required.customer_address.en: The customer's address is missing. An invoice must show the recipient's address (art. 35a Wet OB). Add it to this invoice's customer details.

invoice.required.customer_vat_number.note: FR-AR-003 / D5, and the one message here with TWO next actions — because there genuinely are two. Art. 226(11a): without the number the BTW cannot be reverse-charged, so either the number arrives or the treatment was the wrong choice. Offering only 'add the number' would dead-end somebody invoicing a private individual who has none.
invoice.required.customer_vat_number.nl: Het BTW-nummer van de klant ontbreekt. Bij BTW verlegd en bij een intracommunautaire levering is dat verplicht: zonder dat nummer mag de BTW niet worden verlegd. Vul het nummer in bij de klantgegevens, of kies op die regels een andere BTW-behandeling.
invoice.required.customer_vat_number.en: The customer's BTW number is missing. It is mandatory for BTW verlegd and for an intra-Community supply: without it the BTW cannot be reverse-charged. Add the number to the customer details, or choose a different BTW treatment on those lines.

invoice.required.invoice_date.nl: De factuurdatum ontbreekt. Elke factuur moet gedateerd zijn (art. 35a Wet OB). Kies een datum bovenaan de factuur.
invoice.required.invoice_date.en: The invoice date is missing. Every invoice must be dated (art. 35a Wet OB). Choose a date at the top of the invoice.

invoice.required.lines.note: The 'why' here is not a citation but a consequence, and it is the more useful one: an invoice with no lines describes no supply, and issuing it would spend a number from a gapless series on a document that says nothing.
invoice.required.lines.nl: Deze factuur heeft geen regels en beschrijft dus geen levering. Voeg minstens één regel toe voordat je hem verstuurt.
invoice.required.lines.en: This invoice has no lines, so it describes no supply. Add at least one line before sending it.

invoice.required.line_description.note: {line} is the line's position on the invoice. Every line-level message carries it, because 'a description is missing' against a twelve-line invoice is a dead end of exactly the kind D5 names.
invoice.required.line_description.nl: Regel {line} heeft geen omschrijving. Een factuur moet vermelden wat er geleverd is (art. 35a Wet OB). Beschrijf de goederen of de dienst op die regel.
invoice.required.line_description.en: Line {line} has no description. An invoice must state what was supplied (art. 35a Wet OB). Describe the goods or service on that line.

invoice.required.line_quantity.nl: Regel {line} heeft geen aantal. Een factuur moet de omvang van de levering vermelden (art. 35a Wet OB). Vul een aantal in op die regel.
invoice.required.line_quantity.en: Line {line} has no quantity. An invoice must state the extent of the supply (art. 35a Wet OB). Enter a quantity on that line.

invoice.required.line_unit_price.nl: Regel {line} heeft geen stukprijs. Een factuur moet de prijs exclusief BTW vermelden (art. 35a Wet OB). Vul een stukprijs in op die regel.
invoice.required.line_unit_price.en: Line {line} has no unit price. An invoice must show the price excluding BTW (art. 35a Wet OB). Enter a unit price on that line.

invoice.required.vat_treatment.nl: Regel {line} heeft geen BTW-behandeling. Zonder die keuze kan de BTW niet worden berekend en ziet de klant niet welk tarief geldt. Kies een BTW-behandeling op die regel.
invoice.required.vat_treatment.en: Line {line} has no BTW treatment. Without it the BTW cannot be calculated and the customer cannot see which rate applies. Choose a BTW treatment on that line.

invoice.required.vat_rate.note: CMP-014. The only failure here that is not the user's omission — the ruleset has no rate covering the invoice date — so the next actions include one that is somebody else's: an administrator loading the rates. Saying so is the difference between a dead end and a handover.
invoice.required.vat_rate.nl: Voor de BTW-behandeling op regel {line} is geen tarief bekend op de factuurdatum, dus er valt niets te berekenen. Kies een andere factuurdatum of een andere BTW-behandeling, of laat een beheerder de actuele BTW-tarieven laden.
invoice.required.vat_rate.en: No rate is known for the BTW treatment on line {line} on the invoice date, so there is nothing to calculate with. Choose a different invoice date or BTW treatment, or ask an administrator to load the current BTW rates.

invoice.duplicate.identical.issued.note: SI-12. A WARNING, never a refusal: repeating an invoice is often correct, so the sentence says what was found and what to check, not that anything is wrong. {reference} is the issued invoice's number, {date} its invoice date, {amount} its net total, all already formatted.
invoice.duplicate.identical.issued.nl: Factuur {reference} van {date} aan dezelfde klant heeft dezelfde regels (netto {amount}). Controleer of je niet dezelfde factuur twee keer verstuurt. Is het bedoeld, dan kun je gewoon doorgaan.
invoice.duplicate.identical.issued.en: Invoice {reference} of {date} to the same customer has the same lines (net {amount}). Check that you are not sending the same invoice twice. If it is intended, carry on.

invoice.duplicate.identical.draft.note: SI-12. As invoice.duplicate.identical.issued, for another DRAFT: it has no number yet, so it is identified by its date. Often the half-finished draft somebody forgot they had started.
invoice.duplicate.identical.draft.nl: Er staat al een concept van {date} voor dezelfde klant met dezelfde regels (netto {amount}). Verwijder een van de twee als het er per ongeluk twee zijn. Is het bedoeld, dan kun je gewoon doorgaan.
invoice.duplicate.identical.draft.en: There is already a draft dated {date} for the same customer with the same lines (net {amount}). Delete one of the two if it was created twice by accident. If it is intended, carry on.

invoice.duplicate.same_total.issued.note: SI-12. The weaker match: different lines, same net total. Worded as a possibility, not a finding, because two different jobs can cost the same.
invoice.duplicate.same_total.issued.nl: Factuur {reference} van {date} aan dezelfde klant heeft hetzelfde nettobedrag ({amount}) maar andere regels. Controleer of dit dezelfde levering is die je opnieuw factureert.
invoice.duplicate.same_total.issued.en: Invoice {reference} of {date} to the same customer has the same net amount ({amount}) but different lines. Check whether this is the same supply being invoiced again.

invoice.duplicate.same_total.draft.note: SI-12. As invoice.duplicate.same_total.issued, for another DRAFT.
invoice.duplicate.same_total.draft.nl: Er staat al een concept van {date} voor dezelfde klant met hetzelfde nettobedrag ({amount}) maar andere regels. Controleer of dit dezelfde levering is die je twee keer opvoert.
invoice.duplicate.same_total.draft.en: There is already a draft dated {date} for the same customer with the same net amount ({amount}) but different lines. Check whether this is the same supply entered twice.

invoice.template.locked.quantity_column.note: FR-TPL-009 / D5. api.templates.compliance's counterpart to invoice.required.* above: a template, not a document, is refused. The quantity column cannot be hidden because art. 35a(1)(h)-(i) requires the extent of the supply on every line.
invoice.template.locked.quantity_column.nl: De kolom Aantal kan niet worden verborgen. Een factuur moet de omvang van de levering per regel vermelden (art. 35a lid 1 Wet OB). Zet de kolom weer aan, of verberg in plaats daarvan een niet-verplichte kolom.
invoice.template.locked.quantity_column.en: The Quantity column cannot be hidden. An invoice must state the extent of the supply on every line (art. 35a(1) Wet OB). Turn the column back on, or hide a different, non-mandatory column instead.

invoice.template.locked.unit_price_colum.note: FR-TPL-009 / D5. Art. 35a(1)(i): the price excluding VAT.
invoice.template.locked.unit_price_colum.nl: De kolom Stukprijs kan niet worden verborgen. Een factuur moet de prijs exclusief btw per regel vermelden (art. 35a lid 1 Wet OB). Zet de kolom weer aan.
invoice.template.locked.unit_price_colum.en: The Unit price column cannot be hidden. An invoice must state the price excluding VAT on every line (art. 35a(1) Wet OB). Turn the column back on.

invoice.template.locked.vat_rate_column.note: FR-TPL-009 / D5. Art. 35a(1)(j): the rate applied.
invoice.template.locked.vat_rate_column.nl: De kolom Btw-tarief kan niet worden verborgen. Een factuur moet het toegepaste btw-tarief per regel vermelden (art. 35a lid 1 Wet OB). Zet de kolom weer aan.
invoice.template.locked.vat_rate_column.en: The VAT rate column cannot be hidden. An invoice must state the rate applied on every line (art. 35a(1) Wet OB). Turn the column back on.

invoice.template.locked.legal_identity_v.note: FR-TPL-009 / D5, applied to free text rather than a column. {language} is the endonym of the text that lost the tag (common.language.name.nl / .en), and {tag} is the exact merge tag to retype - a paraphrase would not tell an author what to type back.
invoice.template.locked.legal_identity_v.nl: Het verplichte inhoudsblok mist de placeholder {tag} in de {language} tekst. Een factuur moet het btw-identificatienummer van de verkoper vermelden (art. 35a lid 1 onder c Wet OB). Voeg {tag} terug toe aan die tekst.
invoice.template.locked.legal_identity_v.en: The compulsory content block is missing the {tag} placeholder in its {language} text. An invoice must show the seller's VAT identification number (art. 35a(1)(c) Wet OB). Add {tag} back into that text.

invoice.template.locked.legal_identity_k.note: FR-TPL-009 / D5. Not art. 35a - the KvK number is required on Dutch commercial documents by the Handelsregisterwet, same citation invoice.required.supplier_kvk_number uses.
invoice.template.locked.legal_identity_k.nl: Het verplichte inhoudsblok mist de placeholder {tag} in de {language} tekst. Nederlandse handelsdocumenten moeten het KvK-nummer vermelden (Handelsregisterwet). Voeg {tag} terug toe aan die tekst.
invoice.template.locked.legal_identity_k.en: The compulsory content block is missing the {tag} placeholder in its {language} text. Dutch commercial documents must carry the KvK number (Handelsregisterwet). Add {tag} back into that text.

invoice.template.designer.title.note: FR-TPL-001..009. The designer form's accessible name — `apps/web/src/templates/TemplateDesigner.tsx`.

invoice.template.designer.columns_headin.note: FR-TPL-006. Heading over the six line-item column rows.

invoice.template.designer.blocks_heading.note: FR-TPL-007. Heading over the five content blocks.

invoice.template.designer.locked_column_.note: FR-TPL-009. Accessible name for the lock glyph beside a statutory column — the SHORT label on the icon itself, distinct from the full sentence in invoice.template.locked.*_column beside it.

invoice.template.designer.column_visible.note: FR-TPL-006. Checkbox label for a non-statutory column's show/hide toggle.

invoice.template.designer.move_up.note: FR-TPL-006. Accessible name for a non-statutory column's reorder-up control.

invoice.template.designer.move_down.note: FR-TPL-006. Accessible name for a non-statutory column's reorder-down control.

invoice.template.designer.block.legal_id.note: FR-TPL-007's free block for KvK number, VAT number, IBAN and general terms.

invoice.template.designer.field_nl.note: FR-TPL-013. Label for a content block's Dutch-text field. {block} is one of invoice.template.designer.block.*.

invoice.template.designer.field_en.note: FR-TPL-013. Label for a content block's English-text field.

invoice.template.designer.kvk_pill.note: FR-TPL-009. Visible label on the fixed, non-removable KvK-number pill in the legal_identity block.

invoice.template.designer.vat_pill.note: FR-TPL-009. Visible label on the fixed, non-removable VAT-number pill in the legal_identity block.

invoice.template.designer.other_problems.note: Fallback heading for a violation whose field the designer's own UI has no specific row for — defensive only; the designer's controls are built so this should not be reachable, but the server is the authority and this must not swallow it silently.

invoice.template.designer.logo_heading.note: FR-TPL-001. Heading over the logo upload/position/size controls.

invoice.template.designer.logo_upload.note: FR-TPL-001. Label for the logo file input (accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/svg+xml").

invoice.template.designer.logo_position.note: FR-TPL-001. Label for the closed-set position select.

invoice.template.designer.logo_size.note: FR-TPL-001. Label for the closed-set size select.

invoice.template.designer.logo_preview.note: FR-TPL-001's "transparent-background preview against the paper colour" — accessible name for the preview container, whose background colour is set from template.colors.background.
invoice.template.designer.logo_preview.nl: Voorbeeld van het logo op de papierkleur
invoice.template.designer.logo_preview.en: Preview of the logo against the paper colour

invoice.template.designer.logo_none.note: Shown in place of the preview when no logo has been uploaded yet — the designer's starting state (FR-TPL-001's Logo.asset_id is null).

invoice.template.designer.typography_hea.note: FR-TPL-002/003. Heading over the seven typography selects.

invoice.template.designer.heading_font.note: FR-TPL-002. Label for the heading-font select, populated from FONT_CATALOGUE.

invoice.template.designer.body_font.note: FR-TPL-002. Label for the body-font select.

invoice.template.designer.figures_font.note: FR-TPL-002. Label for the figures-font select — the typeface used for numbers, chosen separately for numeric legibility (tabular figures).

invoice.template.designer.type_scale.note: FR-TPL-003. Label for the type-scale select.

invoice.template.designer.font_weight.note: FR-TPL-003. Label for the font-weight select.

invoice.template.designer.line_height.note: FR-TPL-003. Label for the line-height select.

invoice.template.designer.letter_spacing.note: FR-TPL-003. Label for the letter-spacing select.

invoice.template.designer.layout_heading.note: FR-TPL-005/FR-TPL-010. Heading over the layout/page-setup selects.

invoice.template.designer.layout.note: FR-TPL-005. Label for the starting-layout select.

invoice.template.designer.header_arrange.note: FR-TPL-005. Label for the header-arrangement select - independent of layout.
Today's only pre-existing geometry - logo/adres links, titel/referentie/gegevens rechts.

invoice.template.designer.totals_positio.note: FR-TPL-005. Label for the totals-block-position select.

invoice.template.designer.page_size.note: FR-TPL-010. Label for the page-size select.

invoice.template.designer.page_size.lett.note: FR-LOC-001c keeps 'Letter' untranslated in Dutch - it names a US paper format with no Dutch equivalent name.

invoice.template.designer.margins.note: FR-TPL-010. Label for the margins select.

invoice.template.designer.preview_headin.note: FR-TPL-008. Heading over the live preview panel.

invoice.vat.standard.note: FR-AR-002. The descriptor beside the standard-rate block. The rate itself comes from the effective-dated ruleset (CMP-014) and is not written here — btw_21 was 19% before 2012-10-01.

invoice.vat.reduced.note: FR-AR-002. btw_9 was 6% until 2019, which is why no rate appears in the words.

invoice.vat.zero.note: FR-AR-002. A rate of 0% — taxable, at nothing. Deliberately different wording from 'exempt', which is outside the system entirely and puts a different figure in a different rubriek.

invoice.vat.exempt.note: FR-AR-002 (vrijgesteld). Art. 226(11) requires the invoice to state the reason no VAT is charged; an amount of 0.00 with no statement is not a compliant invoice.

invoice.vat.reverse_charge.note: FR-AR-002 (verlegd), Art. 226(11a). 'BTW verlegd' is the statutory Dutch phrase and is what obliges the BUYER to account for the tax — so it is carried verbatim in the English version too, with a gloss, rather than translated away. The customer's VAT number is mandatory alongside it (see statutory.py).
invoice.vat.reverse_charge.en: BTW verlegd — VAT reverse-charged to the customer

invoice.vat.intra_community.note: FR-AR-002. An intra-Community supply is zero-rated only if the customer's VAT number is on the invoice, which is why statutory.py makes it mandatory for this treatment. Article reference included because Art. 226(11) accepts a reference to the provision as the required statement.
invoice.vat.intra_community.nl: Intracommunautaire levering — BTW verlegd naar de afnemer (art. 138 BTW-richtlijn)
invoice.vat.intra_community.en: Intra-Community supply — BTW verlegd, reverse-charged to the customer (Art. 138 VAT Directive)

invoice.vat.export.note: FR-AR-002. Export outside the EU, zero-rated under Art. 146.
invoice.vat.export.nl: Uitvoer buiten de EU — BTW-nultarief (art. 146 BTW-richtlijn)
invoice.vat.export.en: Export outside the EU — zero BTW rate (Art. 146 VAT Directive)

invoice.vat.margin.note: FR-AR-002 (margeregeling). Under the margin scheme VAT is due on the margin, not the sale price, and stating it separately on the invoice is not permitted — which is why the VAT total for this treatment is zero and its rate is null rather than 0. The buyer cannot deduct it, and the invoice has to say so.
invoice.vat.margin.en: Margin scheme (margeregeling) — BTW is not deductible

invoice.pdf.invoice_title.note: FR-TPL-017 / FR-TPL-013. The heading on the rendered document, in the RECIPIENT language snapshotted onto the invoice at issue - not the language of whoever pressed issue.

invoice.pdf.credit_note_title.note: FR-AR-001. A credit note is its own document with its own number from the same series; the heading has to say so, because a customer filing it beside the invoice it corrects must be able to tell them apart at a glance.

invoice.pdf.invoice_date.note: Art. 226(1). The date of issue, statutory on every invoice.

invoice.pdf.supply_date.note: Art. 226(7). Shown only where it differs from the invoice date, which is when the statute requires it.

invoice.pdf.qr_alt.note: SI-02. FR-TPL-016 alt text for the EPC069-12 QR image - describes its FUNCTION for a screen-reader user, not 'QR code', since the pixels themselves carry no statutory content a text alternative needs to restate.
invoice.pdf.qr_alt.nl: QR-code om deze factuur via uw bank-app te betalen
invoice.pdf.qr_alt.en: QR code to pay this invoice via your banking app

invoice.pdf.due_date.note: FR-AR-006 turns the customer payment terms into this date. Not statutory; it is what gets the invoice paid.

invoice.pdf.customer_vat_number.note: Art. 226(4). Mandatory on a reverse-charge or intra-Community invoice, where the customer VAT number is what makes the treatment lawful.

invoice.pdf.column_unit.note: FR-TPL-006. New with the invoice template designer (api.templates.rendering) - MinimalPdfRenderer never printed a per-line unit, so no header existed for it before.

invoice.pdf.column_vat_rate.note: FR-TPL-006. New with the invoice template designer. MinimalPdfRenderer never shows VAT per line (ADR-037: VAT is grouped by treatment, never per line), so no header existed for this column before either - it appears only in a template preview/future templated renderer, describing the RATE, not an amount.

invoice.pdf.vat_group.note: Art. 226(8) and 226(10): the taxable amount and the VAT PER RATE. One row per VAT treatment on the invoice, never a single combined VAT line - the rate breakdown is what the statute asks for and what the aangifte reads. {rate} is a formatted percentage or a dash for the margin scheme, where stating a rate on the sale price is not permitted.

invoice.pdf.total.note: The amount the customer owes. Deliberately the plain word rather than *including VAT*: the VAT is broken out on the lines above and the reader is looking for what to pay.

invoice.pdf.kvk_number.note: FR-LOC-001c keeps KvK in its Dutch form in the English UI - it names a Dutch register and has no accurate English equivalent.

invoice.pdf.vat_number.note: Art. 226(3). The SUPPLIER own VAT identification number, repeated on every page so a page separated from the rest still identifies who issued it.

invoice.pdf.page.note: FR-TPL-010 page numbering. Written after layout, because *page 1 of 3* cannot be drawn until the third page exists.

invoice.pdf.carried_forward.note: FR-TPL-010's carried-forward subtotal, printed at the bottom of a page that a page break interrupts mid-table - the running net total of every line drawn so far (this page and every prior one). Pairs with invoice.pdf.brought_forward on the next page, which repeats the identical figure. Never printed on a single-page invoice.

invoice.pdf.brought_forward.note: FR-TPL-010's counterpart to invoice.pdf.carried_forward - printed immediately after the repeated table header on the new page, before the first line item resumes. The SAME running total the previous page's carried_forward line just showed.

invoice.email.subject.note: FR-AR-005 / FR-LOC-003. The covering e-mail subject, in the RECIPIENT language frozen onto the invoice at issue - not the sender UI language. Leads with the supplier name because that is what the customer recognises in an inbox; an invoice from a name they do not know reads as spam.

invoice.email.credit_note_subject.note: A credit note is money going back, and a customer filing it beside the invoice it corrects has to tell them apart before opening either.

invoice.email.greeting.note: Deliberately impersonal. The customer master holds an organisation and an invoice address, not a named contact person (FR-AR-006), so a greeting using a name would have no name to use.

invoice.email.intro.note: Says what is attached and for how much. Short on purpose: the authoritative document is the PDF beside it, and a body restating the invoice is a second document to keep in step with the first.
invoice.email.intro.nl: In de bijlage vindt u factuur {reference} van {supplier} voor {amount}.

invoice.email.credit_note_intro.note: No payment is being asked for, so this deliberately does not mention a due date.
invoice.email.credit_note_intro.nl: In de bijlage vindt u creditfactuur {reference} van {supplier} voor {amount}.
invoice.email.credit_note_intro.en: Attached is credit note {reference} from {supplier} for {amount}.

invoice.email.due.note: FR-AR-006 payment terms, as the date on the document. Omitted entirely for a credit note and where the invoice carries no due date - an invented one would be a payment demand nobody agreed.
invoice.email.due.nl: Wij verzoeken u het bedrag van {amount} uiterlijk {due_date} te voldoen.

invoice.email.custom_message_label.note: SI-01. Labels the sender's own free text so it reads as a distinct note, not as more of LEDGR's fixed wording - the recipient should never have to guess which sentences the business actually wrote.

invoice.email.questions.note: Points at the supplier rather than at LEDGR. The business issued the invoice; a question about it is theirs to answer, and directing the customer to the software vendor would be both wrong and unhelpful.
invoice.email.questions.nl: Heeft u vragen over deze factuur? Neem dan contact op met {supplier}.
invoice.email.questions.en: Any questions about this invoice? Please contact {supplier}.

invoice.quote.conversion_error.no_fiscal.note: SI-08. The invoice date falls in no fiscal year, so there is nowhere to put the invoice. The quote stays accepted and can be converted again.
invoice.quote.conversion_error.no_fiscal.nl: De factuurdatum valt in geen enkel boekjaar. Maak het boekjaar aan of kies een andere factuurdatum; de offerte blijft geaccepteerd.
invoice.quote.conversion_error.no_fiscal.en: The invoice date falls in no fiscal year. Create the fiscal year or choose another invoice date; the quote stays accepted.

invoice.quote.conversion_error.customer_.nl: De klant van deze offerte bestaat niet meer. De offerte blijft geaccepteerd.
invoice.quote.conversion_error.customer_.en: This quote's customer no longer exists. The quote stays accepted.

invoice.quote.conversion_error.customer_.nl: De klant van deze offerte is gearchiveerd, dus er wordt niet gefactureerd. Haal de klant uit het archief; de offerte blijft geaccepteerd.
invoice.quote.conversion_error.customer_.en: This quote's customer is archived, so nothing is invoiced. Restore the customer from the archive; the quote stays accepted.

invoice.quote.conversion_error.customer_.note: SI-08 / FR-AR-003. The customer's name and address are needed on an invoice, at the moment they are put on one.
invoice.quote.conversion_error.customer_.nl: De gegevens van de klant zijn onvolledig, meestal het adres. Vul ze aan bij de klant en zet de offerte daarna opnieuw om.
invoice.quote.conversion_error.customer_.en: The customer's details are incomplete, usually the address. Complete them on the customer, then convert the quote again.

invoice.recurring.error.no_fiscal_year.note: SI-07. A run's date falls in no fiscal year of this administration, so there is nowhere to put the invoice. Says how to fix it and that the run will be retried.
invoice.recurring.error.no_fiscal_year.nl: De factuurdatum valt in geen enkel boekjaar. Maak het boekjaar aan; het schema probeert het daarna opnieuw.
invoice.recurring.error.no_fiscal_year.en: The invoice date falls in no fiscal year. Create the fiscal year; the schedule will try again afterwards.

invoice.recurring.error.customer_not_fou.nl: De klant van dit schema bestaat niet meer. Kies een andere klant voor het schema.
invoice.recurring.error.customer_not_fou.en: This schedule's customer no longer exists. Choose another customer for the schedule.

invoice.recurring.error.customer_archive.note: SI-07. An archived customer is not invoiced. Names both ways out.
invoice.recurring.error.customer_archive.nl: De klant van dit schema is gearchiveerd, dus er wordt niet gefactureerd. Haal de klant uit het archief of beëindig het schema.
invoice.recurring.error.customer_archive.en: This schedule's customer is archived, so nothing is invoiced. Restore the customer from the archive or end the schedule.

invoice.recurring.error.customer_details.note: SI-07. FR-AR-003 needs the customer's name and address on an invoice, at the moment it is put on one.
invoice.recurring.error.customer_details.nl: De gegevens van de klant zijn onvolledig, meestal het adres. Vul ze aan bij de klant; het schema probeert het daarna opnieuw.
invoice.recurring.error.customer_details.en: The customer's details are incomplete, usually the address. Complete them on the customer; the schedule will try again afterwards.

invoice.recurring.issue_error.not_author.note: SI-07. The schedule asked to issue its invoices but the person who ran it may not (issuing needs the send permission). The invoice was created as a draft.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.not_author.nl: Het schema is ingesteld om te versturen, maar jij mag facturen niet definitief maken. De factuur staat als concept klaar.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.not_author.en: The schedule is set to issue its invoices, but you may not issue them. The invoice was created as a draft.

invoice.recurring.issue_error.not_statut.note: SI-07 / FR-AR-003. The invoice lacks something the law requires (often the supplier's KvK or VAT number). Left as a draft so a person can complete it.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.not_statut.nl: De factuur mist iets wat wettelijk verplicht is, bijvoorbeeld een KvK- of btw-nummer. Ze staat als concept klaar; vul het aan en maak haar dan definitief.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.not_statut.en: The invoice lacks something the law requires, for example a KvK or VAT number. It was left as a draft; complete it, then issue it.

invoice.recurring.issue_error.no_open_pe.note: SI-07. The invoice date is in a locked or filed period. Left as a draft.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.no_open_pe.nl: De factuurdatum valt in een gesloten periode. De factuur staat als concept klaar.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.no_open_pe.en: The invoice date falls in a closed period. The invoice was left as a draft.

invoice.recurring.issue_error.no_sales_j.note: SI-07. FR-GL-002: the administration has no single active sales journal.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.no_sales_j.nl: Er is geen verkoopjournaal ingericht. De factuur staat als concept klaar.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.no_sales_j.en: No sales journal is set up. The invoice was left as a draft.

invoice.recurring.issue_error.posting_un.note: SI-07. A revenue or VAT account is not mapped for this invoice's treatment. Left as a draft.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.posting_un.nl: Er is geen omzet- of btw-rekening gekoppeld voor deze factuur. De factuur staat als concept klaar.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.posting_un.en: No revenue or VAT account is mapped for this invoice. The invoice was left as a draft.

invoice.recurring.issue_error.template_n.note: SI-07. The invoice template cannot be rendered (for example its logo). Left as a draft.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.template_n.nl: De factuursjabloon kan niet worden weergegeven, bijvoorbeeld door het logo. De factuur staat als concept klaar.
invoice.recurring.issue_error.template_n.en: The invoice template cannot be rendered, for example because of its logo. The invoice was left as a draft.

invoice.ageing.bucket.current.note: SI-06 / FR-AR-012. Ageing is by days past the DUE date, the Dutch convention: an invoice on 60-day terms is not late at day 45. The due date itself is still 'current' - the customer has until the end of it.

invoice.ageing.bucket.days_1_30.note: SI-06. First late day to thirty days late, inclusive.

invoice.ageing.bucket.over_90.note: SI-06. Open-ended: everything more than ninety days late.

invoice.ageing.bucket.no_due_date.note: SI-06. An invoice with no due date cannot be late, and inventing one would put it in a bucket on a term nobody agreed. Counted in the totals, shown separately.

invoice.statement.kind.invoice.note: SI-06 / FR-AR-012. A statement line: an invoice raises what the customer owes.

invoice.statement.kind.credit_note.note: SI-06. A credit note lowers what the customer owes.

invoice.statement.kind.payment.note: SI-06. A payment received, on the day the money arrived.

invoice.statement.kind.payment_void.note: SI-06. A payment that was recorded in error and reversed: it raises what the customer owes again, on the day it was voided.

invoice.statement.kind.write_off.note: SI-10 / FR-AR-013. An invoice written off as uncollectable: it lowers what the customer owes without a payment.

invoice.statement.kind.write_off_void.note: SI-10. A write-off that was reversed: it raises what the customer owes again, on the day it was voided.

invoice.dunning.blocker.nothing_outstand.note: SI-04. Outranks every other reason: a paid or credited invoice is never chased, paused or not.
invoice.dunning.blocker.nothing_outstand.nl: Er staat niets meer open op deze factuur, dus er is niets om te herinneren.
invoice.dunning.blocker.nothing_outstand.en: Nothing is outstanding on this invoice, so there is nothing to remind about.

invoice.dunning.blocker.paused.note: SI-04. The customer is paused. Says how to resume, because a pause is somebody's decision and the next action is theirs.
invoice.dunning.blocker.paused.nl: Herinneringen voor deze klant staan op pauze. Hervat ze bij de klant om de aanmaanprocedure voort te zetten.
invoice.dunning.blocker.paused.en: Reminders for this customer are paused. Resume them on the customer to carry on chasing.

invoice.dunning.blocker.no_due_date.note: SI-04. Without a due date there is no 'overdue' - inventing one would be a payment demand nobody agreed.
invoice.dunning.blocker.no_due_date.nl: Deze factuur heeft geen vervaldatum, dus ze kan niet te laat zijn. Er wordt geen herinnering verstuurd.
invoice.dunning.blocker.no_due_date.en: This invoice has no due date, so it cannot be overdue. No reminder is sent.

invoice.dunning.blocker.not_overdue.note: SI-04. The due date itself is not overdue - the customer has until the end of it.
invoice.dunning.blocker.not_overdue.nl: Deze factuur is nog niet verlopen. Er wordt geen herinnering verstuurd.
invoice.dunning.blocker.not_overdue.en: This invoice is not overdue yet. No reminder is sent.

invoice.dunning.blocker.step_not_due.note: SI-04. The next step exists but its day has not come.
invoice.dunning.blocker.step_not_due.nl: De volgende herinnering is nog niet aan de beurt. Wacht tot het aantal dagen na de vervaldatum is bereikt.
invoice.dunning.blocker.step_not_due.en: The next reminder is not due yet. Wait until the configured number of days after the due date.

invoice.dunning.blocker.ladder_complete.note: SI-04. Every step has been sent. What follows a formal notice (collection, write-off) is a decision, not another email.
invoice.dunning.blocker.ladder_complete.nl: Alle herinneringen voor deze factuur zijn verstuurd. Overweeg de volgende stap zelf, bijvoorbeeld incasso of afschrijving.
invoice.dunning.blocker.ladder_complete.en: Every reminder for this invoice has been sent. Decide the next step yourself, for example collection or a write-off.

invoice.dunning.blocker.too_soon.note: SI-11 / FR-AR-010. The last reminder went out fewer than 7 days ago. Steps are spaced from the due date, so without this a far-overdue invoice would get every step in a row; and it is what makes repeating a bulk chase safe.
invoice.dunning.blocker.too_soon.nl: Er is minder dan zeven dagen geleden al een herinnering verstuurd voor deze factuur. De volgende volgt zodra er genoeg tijd verstreken is.
invoice.dunning.blocker.too_soon.en: A reminder about this invoice went out less than seven days ago. The next one follows once enough time has passed.

invoice.chase.skip.needs_confirmation.note: SI-11. A formal notice claims interest and collection costs, so a bulk 'chase everything' never sends one: a person must choose that invoice. Says how.
invoice.chase.skip.needs_confirmation.nl: Dit is een aanmaning, met rente en incassokosten. Die verstuur je niet in bulk: kies deze factuur zelf om de aanmaning te versturen.
invoice.chase.skip.needs_confirmation.en: This is a formal notice, with interest and collection costs. It is not sent in bulk: choose this invoice yourself to send the notice.

invoice.chase.skip.step_changed.note: SI-11. The person reviewed one step and a different one is now next (a stale preview, or a repeated request). Skipped rather than sent as whatever the step has become.
invoice.chase.skip.step_changed.nl: De volgende herinnering voor deze factuur is intussen een andere dan die je bekeek. Er is niets verstuurd; bekijk de factuur opnieuw.
invoice.chase.skip.step_changed.en: The next reminder for this invoice is no longer the one you reviewed. Nothing was sent; review the invoice again.

invoice.chase.skip.not_overdue_or_unknow.note: SI-11. Named in the request but not overdue in this administration - paid since, or never here. The two look the same on purpose.
invoice.chase.skip.not_overdue_or_unknow.nl: Deze factuur is niet (meer) achterstallig. Er is niets verstuurd.
invoice.chase.skip.not_overdue_or_unknow.en: This invoice is not (or no longer) overdue. Nothing was sent.

invoice.chase.skip.deferred.note: SI-11. Over the per-call limit. Repeating the call is safe: anyone already reminded is skipped as too soon.
invoice.chase.skip.deferred.nl: Niet verstuurd omdat er per keer een maximumaantal herinneringen wordt verstuurd. Herhaal de actie voor de rest.
invoice.chase.skip.deferred.en: Not sent because only a limited number of reminders are sent at a time. Repeat the action for the rest.

invoice.chase.failure.unreachable.note: SI-11. The customer has no e-mail address on file. Says what to do: add one, or send it another way.
invoice.chase.failure.unreachable.nl: Deze klant heeft geen e-mailadres. Voeg er een toe bij de klant of stuur de herinnering op een andere manier.
invoice.chase.failure.unreachable.en: This customer has no e-mail address. Add one on the customer, or send the reminder another way.

invoice.chase.failure.not_rendered.note: SI-11. Only reachable for an invoice issued before migration 0040, which did not render a PDF at issue (FR-TPL-017).
invoice.chase.failure.not_rendered.nl: Van deze factuur is geen PDF bewaard, dus er kan geen herinnering met bijlage worden verstuurd.
invoice.chase.failure.not_rendered.en: No PDF was stored for this invoice, so a reminder with an attachment cannot be sent.

invoice.chase.failure.not_delivered.note: SI-11. The e-mail provider did not accept the message, so it was not sent and the step is still due.
invoice.chase.failure.not_delivered.nl: De e-mailprovider heeft de herinnering niet geaccepteerd, dus die is niet verstuurd. Probeer het later opnieuw.
invoice.chase.failure.not_delivered.en: The e-mail provider did not accept the reminder, so it was not sent. Try again later.

invoice.chase.failure.already_sent.note: SI-11. Two requests raced to send one step. Worth checking whether the customer received it twice.
invoice.chase.failure.already_sent.nl: Deze herinneringsstap was al verstuurd, bijna gelijktijdig door een andere actie. Controleer of de klant hem dubbel kreeg.
invoice.chase.failure.already_sent.en: This reminder step had already been sent, almost simultaneously by another action. Check whether the customer received it twice.

invoice.chase.failure.unavailable.note: SI-11. The customer's preferred channel cannot be used by this deployment.
invoice.chase.failure.unavailable.nl: Het verzendkanaal voor deze klant is niet beschikbaar. Er is niets verstuurd.
invoice.chase.failure.unavailable.en: The delivery channel for this customer is not available. Nothing was sent.

invoice.dunning.blocker.interest_rate_mi.note: SI-04. The step charges statutory interest and no rate is loaded for the date. Refused rather than sent without or with a guess. Two ways out, named: load the rates, or stop charging interest on that step.
invoice.dunning.blocker.interest_rate_mi.nl: Deze herinnering brengt wettelijke rente in rekening, maar er is geen rentepercentage geladen voor deze periode. Laat een beheerder de wettelijke rente laden, of zet rente uit voor deze stap.
invoice.dunning.blocker.interest_rate_mi.en: This reminder charges statutory interest, but no interest rate is loaded for this period. Ask an administrator to load the statutory rates, or turn interest off for this step.

invoice.reminder.subject.friendly.note: SI-04 / FR-LOC-003. The recipient's language, frozen on the invoice. The gentlest step: a subject that says 'reminder', not 'overdue', because most first reminders go to somebody who simply missed it.

invoice.reminder.subject.formal_notice.note: SI-04. NEEDS LEGAL REVIEW. 'Aanmaning' is the word the WIK's 14-day requirement attaches to, so it is carried in Dutch and named plainly in English.
invoice.reminder.subject.formal_notice.en: Formal notice of payment: invoice {reference} from {supplier}

invoice.reminder.intro.friendly.note: SI-04. Assumes nothing: 'may have slipped your attention'. No claim beyond the invoice itself - no interest, no costs. The invoice is attached again so the customer has what they need to pay.
invoice.reminder.intro.friendly.nl: Mogelijk is het aan uw aandacht ontsnapt: factuur {reference} van {supplier} met vervaldatum {due_date} staat nog open voor {outstanding}. In de bijlage vindt u de factuur nogmaals.
invoice.reminder.intro.friendly.en: It may have slipped your attention: invoice {reference} from {supplier}, due on {due_date}, is still open for {outstanding}. The invoice is attached again.

invoice.reminder.intro.reminder.note: SI-04. {days} is whole days past the due date. Firmer, still no claim beyond the invoice.
invoice.reminder.intro.reminder.nl: Factuur {reference} van {supplier} is {days} dagen na de vervaldatum ({due_date}) nog niet betaald. Het openstaande bedrag is {outstanding}. Wij verzoeken u dit alsnog te voldoen.
invoice.reminder.intro.reminder.en: Invoice {reference} from {supplier} is still unpaid {days} days after its due date ({due_date}). The outstanding amount is {outstanding}. Please pay it as soon as possible.

invoice.reminder.intro.formal_notice.note: SI-04. NEEDS LEGAL REVIEW. The aanmaning: it must give the debtor a last chance to pay before costs are claimed, so the deadline is stated as a date ({pay_by}), not as 'promptly'.
invoice.reminder.intro.formal_notice.nl: Ondanks eerdere herinneringen hebben wij geen betaling ontvangen voor factuur {reference} van {supplier} (vervaldatum {due_date}). Het openstaande bedrag is {outstanding}. Dit is een aanmaning: wij verzoeken u dit bedrag uiterlijk {pay_by} te betalen.
invoice.reminder.intro.formal_notice.en: Despite earlier reminders we have not received payment for invoice {reference} from {supplier} (due {due_date}). The outstanding amount is {outstanding}. This is a formal notice: please pay this amount by {pay_by}.

invoice.reminder.interest.note: SI-04. NEEDS LEGAL REVIEW. {interest} is the statutory interest accrued up to the day of sending. Says it keeps accruing, because the amount stated is a snapshot.
invoice.reminder.interest.nl: Tot en met vandaag is {interest} aan wettelijke rente opgebouwd; de rente loopt door tot de dag van betaling.
invoice.reminder.interest.en: Statutory interest of {interest} has accrued up to today and continues to accrue until payment.

invoice.reminder.collection_cost.note: SI-04. NEEDS LEGAL REVIEW. A CONDITIONAL statement: costs are charged if payment is not received by {pay_by}. It announces the cost the WIK allows on this debt ({cost}), it does not add it to what is owed today.
invoice.reminder.collection_cost.nl: Betaalt u niet uiterlijk {pay_by}, dan brengen wij buitengerechtelijke incassokosten in rekening van {cost}.
invoice.reminder.collection_cost.en: If payment is not received by {pay_by}, we will charge extrajudicial collection costs of {cost}.
